metric_definitions.exact_trip_accuracy: Correct MATCHED decisions / labeled scheduled episodes; abstention counts as incorrect.
metric_definitions.top3_coverage: True occurrence in first three ranked diagnostic candidates, regardless of abstention.
metric_definitions.reported_top3_coverage: True occurrence in first three final reported scheduled candidates.
metric_definitions.adjacent_trip_confusion: Wrong MATCHED adjacent occurrence / episodes with independently supplied adjacent-trip IDs.
metric_definitions.delay_mae_s: Absolute delay error among correctly identified MATCHED episodes with independent delay labels.
metric_definitions.abstention_rate: Fraction of all persisted cases whose status is not MATCHED; descriptive without labels.
metric_definitions.calibration_error: Top-ranked calibrated candidate equal-width reliability ECE on independent test episodes.
metric_definitions.inferred_delay_regime_stratum: Model routine/disruption responsibility grouping; not independent operating-regime truth. Accuracy metrics still require test labels.
metric_definitions.boundary_f1: One-to-one boundary event F1 within configured seconds tolerance.

high_headway_definition: Common source/target candidate identities; old median and any-point >=3500s counts reported separately, each candidate once per case/mode.
validation_scope: All score/clock/projection records; canonical cohort/headway recomputation at each candidate anchor and retained window cohort; all protected nearest, simultaneous and adjacent occurrences checked. No fitted delay was recomputed.
